answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing, and their standing: (a) outline 5.4.3.8 already says the launcher is Python and 5.4.3.8.1 the thin platform shell; this parent implements those lines, it does not set them. bin/cairn.cmd is already that shell on Windows and stays. (b) Akien's scope answer 2026-11-22 (relayed by akiendell_cc_0, AskUserQuestion): ONE Python superclaude on every box, Linux included, so the bash superclaude is deleted, not kept beside. (c) Every OS difference in the launch path is answered by a tool the system device publishes (Akien: 'hostname should come from the system device'; memory hostname-comes-from-the-system-device).
